title: Cat in a Pumpkin

steps.heading: Start with the outline
steps.caption: Protect your table. Follow the preprinted lines. Keep the background white. Use thin coats; rinse and blot between colors.

steps.heading: Orange pumpkin base
steps.caption: Paint the pumpkin shell and rim orange in thin coats. Leave the carved face, opening and kitten white.

steps.heading: Charcoal kitten
steps.caption: Mix black with white and a touch of blue for charcoal gray. Paint the head, paws and curled tail; leave inner ears and nose clear.

steps.heading: Rose ears & nose
steps.caption: Mix white with a little red and a tiny touch of brown for dusty rose. Paint the inner ears, nose and tongue.

steps.heading: Golden eyes
steps.caption: Mix yellow with a little brown for gold. Fill the small curved eye rims; keep the black pupils and white glints distinct.

steps.heading: Deep carved shapes
steps.caption: Mix black with a little brown. Fill the pumpkin eyes, nose and mouth, plus the opening behind the cat. Keep the teeth orange.

steps.heading: Round the pumpkin
steps.caption: Mix orange with brown for the grooves. Mix orange with yellow for rib highlights. Curve each stroke down the pumpkin.

steps.heading: Soft directional fur
steps.caption: Mix white, black and a touch of blue for lighter gray. Pull short strokes over the dry charcoal, following cheeks and tail.

steps.heading: Light along the rim
steps.caption: Mix orange with yellow and a little white. Trace a narrow highlight on the front rim and the upper edges of pumpkin ribs.

steps.heading: Small paw highlights
steps.caption: Mix white with a little black and brown for warm gray. Add short strokes on the paw tops; keep the toe divisions darker.

steps.heading: Whiskers & eye shine
steps.caption: Let the face dry. Use black and a fine brush to tidy whiskers and the smile. Add a small white dot to each eye.

steps.heading: Dry & clean up
steps.caption: Lay the canvas flat until fully dry. Wash brushes, wipe the palette and close the paint pots.

materials: Preprinted 8 x 10 canvas; acrylic paints; large and small brushes; water cup; paper towels; palette or paper plate.
